mod.name: DTMAPI Action Speed
config.status.unsupported: Verified in third-save smoke: tool animation, eat/drink animation, bottled-water right-click continuous drink, IWaterContainer and in-water bottle fill, no-key auto-fill, planting, fuel/feed add, plant-basin crop harvest, resin collection, and wild vegetation harvest. Fertilizer/crop-film attempts, animal fondle, and electric sprinkler/grow-light switch paths were added in 0616 and still need third-save manual QA.
